title: pmic_seq: power-good delay tuned to NB54360 soft-start
description: The FW-PMIC-SEQ power sequencing module waits 6 ms for power-good, tuned to the NB54360 4 ms soft-start time. Any regulator change on PSU-24 needs a firmware review of the power-good delay, otherwise the VX7 MCU can brown out during cold start.

comments.author: Rahul Iyer
comments.body: Merged. Added a comment in pmic_seq.c pointing at this ticket. Regulator changes must loop in Firmware.
